note: Edited by hand for copy; version/status/downloads are overwritten by sync.py. Keep `source` and `modrinth` accurate or sync skips the entry.

projects.name: Art Snap
projects.blurb: Save, export, and import map art between worlds. Preserves custom names, formatting, and enchantments.
projects.detail: Clones the raw .dat file so a map survives the trip between worlds intact — custom name, formatting codes, enchantments and all. Stays compatible with vanilla map rendering, so exported art loads on any server without the mod.

projects.name: Death On The Spot
projects.blurb: Full inventory saved to JSON on death, retrieved through a GUI at designated death chests.
projects.detail: Kotlin plugin that writes the complete inventory to JSON the moment a player dies, then hands it back through a chest GUI. Handles double chests, and cleans up the stored file once everything has actually been recovered.

projects.name: Matt's Mods
projects.blurb: Admin utilities: a changelog system, and inventory backup triggered by right-clicking a bed.
projects.detail: Two things that kept getting rebuilt by hand on every server: a changelog admins can post and players can read in-game, and an inventory snapshot taken when you right-click a bed, so there's a restore point before anything risky.

projects.name: Shopah
projects.blurb: Item-for-item trading shops built from a sign on a chest. No economy plugin required.
projects.detail: Put a sign on a chest or barrel and it becomes a shop that trades items directly — no currency, no economy plugin, no server-wide setup. Pricing is per-shop, and the sign shows live stock so players know before they walk over.

projects.name: DeathChestReborn
projects.blurb: Death inventories preserved in admin-registered chests, with GUI retrieval and storage limits.
projects.detail: Saves inventory, armour and offhand on death, then serves it back from chests an admin registers. Chests can render as a custom model through a resource pack, pair into double chests with permission-gated expansion, and survive explosions. Storage limits are configurable per server.
projects.exclude_note: abandoned line: both built 2026-05-25, 1.2.1 shipped after on 2026-05-26

projects.name: ForkInteractions
projects.blurb: Non-Loyalty tridents drop their owner on landing, so anyone can pick them up.
projects.detail: A thrown trident without Loyalty normally stays bound to whoever threw it. This releases that claim once it lands, which is what most people expect it to do. Paper only, and there is nothing to configure.

projects.name: SuperUtilities
projects.blurb: Admin commands for GriefPrevention — list, teleport to, and delete claims.
projects.detail: Paginated claim listing with teleport and delete, for servers where GriefPrevention claims pile up faster than anyone can audit them. Reads through EssentialsX where available so player data resolves to real names.

projects.name: wtf
projects.blurb: A searchable ledger of every chest and shulker box you've touched — what's inside and where you left it.
projects.detail: Mark a container to start tracking it, and the mod keeps a running record of its contents and last known position. Shulker boxes are followed through inventory, placement, breaking, dropping, and hopper extraction, so the entry stays accurate when the box moves. A searchable grid screen finds any item across everything tracked.

projects.name: CAPSlock
projects.blurb: Quietly fixes capitalization on outgoing chat. No yelling, no autocorrect feel.
projects.detail: Client-side sentence casing applied as messages leave your client. It leaves slash commands and their arguments alone, so nothing breaks when you type a command in a hurry.

projects.name: Noted
projects.blurb: In-game notes, so you can write something down without alt-tabbing away.
projects.detail: A small client-side notes screen that persists across sessions. Built for the things you lose otherwise — coordinates, a redstone timing, what you were doing before you logged off.

projects.name: ptime
projects.blurb: Client-side time of day. Set your own lighting without touching the server.
projects.detail: Locks your visual time of day locally — permanent noon for building, permanent night if you prefer it — while the server and everyone on it stay unaffected. Also tracks other players' timezones from the client.

projects.name: Parakon
projects.blurb: Push-to-toggle live transcription that types straight at your text cursor.
projects.detail: Hit the hotkey and talk; audio is chunked on silence, transcribed in order, and typed wherever your cursor already is. Because it types rather than showing a window, it works in any application. Runs as a hotkey-bound CLI or a small GUI with start, stop and settings.

projects.name: speak
projects.blurb: Pipe text in, hear it spoken. Voice-cloning TTS on the GPU, with a fast CPU fallback.
projects.detail: Wraps a 0.6B zero-shot voice-cloning model running in ONNX, about 0.7× realtime on a 4060, with piper as the fallback when there is no GPU. Rotates voices per chunk for multi-speaker narration, splits long passages on sentence boundaries, and stops the moment you kill it rather than finishing the sentence.

projects.name: Models & Textures
projects.blurb: Blockbench models and hand-painted textures — masks, weapons, creature variants.
projects.detail: A Rimuru mask taken through several revisions, a Masamune blade with both detailed and deliberately blocky texture treatments, and an axolotl variant. Modelled in Blockbench. Drag any of them to turn it.
